scenario: You receive a text message from a friend you haven’t met saying they will be 20 minutes early.
Someone hands you a signed check without asking for a letter of introduction.
A colleague shares a draft of their personal financial spreadsheet with you for review before anyone else sees it.
A new neighbor leaves their key in your mailbox while running an errand.
You are told by a landlord that the hot water is broken, and you decide to stay home for the night.
You accept a drink from a stranger who says it is medicine and points a glass at you.
A family friend asks you to keep a secret about a breakup for exactly one year.
You see a child drop a toy and bend down to pick it up without expecting to be thanked.
A contractor sends you the final invoice before you have inspected the finished remodeling project.
An acquaintance waves at you across the street and jogs toward you to give you mail.
You notice a locked door with a note taped to it saying the owner is visiting a relative in another state with no set return date.
A partner hands you the house keys while explaining that they will be called into an unexpected meeting for an hour.
You are given a list of your bank account numbers and told someone needs them to set up a direct deposit.
A stranger at a café asks to pay for your coffee in case you’re in a rush.
You learn that your child’s teacher is having a child of her own, but she does not mention the teacher’s name.
You agree to drive Car B after someone says they need to drop off a package and will be back in five minutes.
A coworker brings lunch for the whole team while you are out sick in the hospital.
You are told a colleague’s password needs to be reset, and they give it to you to reset themselves remotely.
You receive an invoice with a bank draft that has not yet cleared but is dated for next month.
A friend asks you to watch their pet while they are at a wedding and promises no extra details.
A company tells you customers will be notified directly via their own email address.
You are told a price will not change for a weekend sale and asked to tour the store at different times during the weekend.
A new server administrator tells you their admin password will be changed in a week.
A neighbor lets you take their driveway to deliver an empty package while they go grocery shopping by themselves.
You receive a package from an unknown sender but the return address is a friend’s address.
You are offered a lesser-known job offer with a start date that is eight days from now.
A new contractor says they finished the plumbing and tells you not to call the plumber until tomorrow.
You are told your child’s school will call you before the parent meeting at 5:00 PM.
A friend lets you use their car without a set time restriction while they complete a dentist appointment.
You are invited to a dinner party where you are told there will be no surprise guests.
A person offers you an item they claim is theirs simply out of goodwill and you accept them without inspection.
You are told that all expenses will be covered by a third party, and you sign a credit card form without seeing the third-party letter.
A stranger at a bus stop tells you they will pay your next fare if you give them yours.
You are given a hospital visitor’s badge by a nurse who says the person is waiting outside.
A friend wants to buy you a surprise gift and tells you no one else knows about the surprise.
You are told a bank representative will call you at 2:00 PM to confirm your account balance.
A neighbor asks to borrow a drill and promises to bring tools back today.
You are told your credit card statement includes a fee due within 24 hours of receiving it.
A friend sends you a voice message saying they were in trouble at the restaurant earlier and you cut off your numbers.
You are told your bank card will be replaced at an unknown time and you keep the card on your desk.
A co-worker says they will replace your lunch tomorrow and promises to bring it at 12:00 PM.
You are given a referral to a friend who owns a construction company, without asking for previous references.
A neighbor says they lent you their phone and wants to get it back before 6:00 PM.
You are told that all parking tickets will be covered by insurance, and you decide to not file a report.
A friend asks to borrow $50 and says they will return it in exactly three days.
Someone tells you your delivery is printed in a specific number without explaining why.
A pet sitter warns you that your cat is territorial with other dogs.
You receive a color photograph in an email from someone you’ve answered a survey for online.
A stranger says they are in a hurry to meet a doctor they need an X-ray for because a bus ran out of money.
You are told a friend’s story is based on a news article, but they don’t want you checking to see if it is true.
